name: sentiment_context
description: ADVISORY conversational TONE + URGENCY context for a single message (improvement doc A1 / P2-01). Deterministic keyword+punctuation heuristics with a CONFIDENCE score, no model required. Returns {tone, urgency, confidence, basis:direct|inferred, correctable}. HARD GUARDRAILS: classifies the message's tone/urgency ONLY; never claims to know Ross's private mental state; never makes medical/psychological diagnoses; always records confidence (never 1.0); distinguishes DIRECT statements from INFERENCE; Ross can CORRECT any call (action='correct'); NEVER alters Wren's persona — it is context she READS. Appends every call to data/registries/qsb_wren_sentiment_log.jsonl (append-only, with a correction field). action='infer_mental_state'|'diagnose'|'read_mind' is REFUSED by design.

action.description: classify a message | record a Ross correction | tail recent log rows

message.description: classify: the message text to classify (tone/urgency only)

classification_id.description: correct: id of the classification being corrected

limit.description: recent: how many rows to tail

authored_by: Claude for Wren (additive advisory skill, A1/P2-01)
guardrails: confidence recorded on every call, never 1.0
